summary: Review herd records, feed budgets and production indicators through practical farm exercises. Explore the animal production course and its curriculum.
lede: Animal production training helps livestock officers, farm supervisors and animal science practitioners plan and review herd operations using production records and feed budgets. You’ll practise calculating feed conversion ratio and average daily gain, organizing breeding and inventory records, and using Excel to review production trends and prepare seasonal feed plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people responsible for livestock output, day-to-day farm decisions and the records used to explain production performance.
prerequisites: No prerequisite information was supplied. The course uses basic livestock production records and Excel examples; programming is not required.
